_readme: The photos that cycle at the top of three views, in play order, one list (Sam, 2026-11-12, #3153: "this is where we should list our photos we cycle on our cobi views as well"). COBI's First Light tab (first_light_tab.js) reads it. The three views still carry their own copies of this order until phase B points them here; tests/first_light_tab.test.js fails if any copy differs from this file. file is relative to library/photos/. On the public views every photo is decorative (alt="", aria-hidden); alt here describes each photo for the First Light tab only. The first is the student from Malone's page; the other ten are the Career Education toolkit photos Sam supplied (Sheet 124 card 1), cropped 4:3.

A dental student in a mask, loupes and a disposable gown works with instruments in gloved hands.
Three fashion students lean over a cutting table, one explaining as the others watch.
